notes: snr_estimate with qam1024 and a window of 512 symbols: input are 18 windows of random 1024-QAM symbols (unit-power grid, amplitude 0.6) with complex Gaussian noise at Es/N0 34 dB (windows 0 to 5), 20 dB (6 to 11) and 8 dB (12 to 17); expected is the estimate in dB after each window from window 1 on (window 0 only measures the amplitude), from the f64 model of the estimator: decisions at the amplitude of the previous window, the least-squares gain, the inverse of the reading table over white Gaussian noise (SciPy), the amplitude from the fitted gain from 30.5 dB on and from M2M4 (held between M2 / 11 and M2) below; within 0.01 dB (a float32 decision at a boundary)
